verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.useautumn.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured index linking to markdown pages. Every cited docs page is served as raw .md (e.g. check.md, mcp.md, cli/getting-started.md), so an agent can be pointed straight at machine-readable docs. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or agent-specific usage guidance, and no independent or hands-on report of agents consuming these docs.
